name: Mod Profiles
description: Save, switch and share complete mod setups as profiles

move-mod-files.name: Switch mod files, not just toggles
move-mod-files.description:
Applying a profile <cg>moves the .geode files</c>: everything the profile does not list leaves <cy>geode/mods</c> for <cy>geode/mod-profiles-vault</c>, and everything it does list comes back from there. Your mod list then holds exactly the profile, instead of a long list of disabled mods.

Turn this off to only flip Geode's enabled/disabled switches and leave every file in place.

Nothing is ever deleted either way - <cj>Vault</c> in the profile list puts everything back.

auto-backup.name: Backup before applying
auto-backup.description: Before a profile is applied, save the current enabled/disabled state into an automatic profile called <cy>Auto backup</c>, so a wrong switch can always be undone.

disable-unlisted.name: Disable unlisted mods
disable-unlisted.description: When a profile is applied, also disable every installed mod the profile does not mention, so your setup matches it exactly. Nothing is ever deleted - the mods stay installed and can be re-enabled at any time.

allow-self-disable.name: Allow disabling Mod Profiles
allow-self-disable.description:
Let profiles disable <cy>Mod Profiles</c> itself. Off by default, because once it is disabled you have to re-enable it by hand through the Geode menu before you can switch profiles again.

This only applies to toggling: when <cj>Switch mod files</c> is on, this mod's own file always stays in <cy>geode/mods</c>, otherwise the vault could no longer be reached.

download-missing.name: Download missing mods
download-missing.description: When importing a profile, download the mods it lists that are not installed yet. Mods stored inside the profile file are always installed from the file; this setting only controls downloads from the <cy>Geode index</c> and from URLs.
